names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 10 noiembrie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιος Ορέστης», with the rank word left off.

The heading of the calendar's name page 1678, «Орест Тианский (Каппадокийский), мч.», with the rank word left off; the second epithet is parenthesised on the page itself. The day's line declines the name and gives his trade instead of an epithet, «Мч. Ореста врача».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 10. новембар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Орест.“ — «Св.» is “saint” and «муч.» the `martyr` grade `types` keeps, so both come off and nothing is left but the bare forename; the city in the display name is this corpus’s own and is not in the heading, though the body gives it twice.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 ноября ст. ст. — «Мч. Ореста врача (304).»
doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 10 noiembrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Orest»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Ορέστης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man of Tyana in Cappadocia, dragged to death behind a horse under the governor Maximus. It prints an apolytikion that names him, taken here. The year it gives is for the persecution and not for him — «Την περίοδο του Διοκλητιανού διωγμού (περί το 289 μ.Χ.)» — so no `dates` object is proposed on the strength of it. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 23.11.2025 (10. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Орест.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, and the longest of the three: where this folder had a line it now has two speeches of his own and the whole order of the torments. `dates` UNTOUCHED — the entry names the reign of Diocletian and prints no year, and the folder already holds 304. `types` untouched: «муч.» is the `martyr` grade it holds and «лекар по занимању», a physician by trade, is its `physician`. ONE `related` ROW ADDED, one way: the entry closes on an apparition no other calendar this folder cites records — he appeared to Demetrius of Rostov and showed him all the wounds on his body — so the life links that folder and owes it a row. It is not written in the other direction: the reading is in this book’s account of the martyr, and nothing read was consulted on the side of the metropolitan who saw him. NO `locations`: Tyana in Cappadocia is named and is already inside the Russian name form.

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne, Orest, întru nevoinţa sa, cununa nestricăciunii a dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru; că având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Orest (a common of a single martyr, with his name in it)

english.text: Thy martyr Orestes, O Lord, in his contest received from Thee, our God, the crown of incorruption; for having Thy power he overthrew the tormentors, and broke the powerless presumption of the demons. By his prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Χριστὸν ὁμολογήσας ἐπὶ τῶν ἀσεβούντων, εἰδωλομανίας τὸ θράσος καθεῖλες Ἀθλοφόρε, καὶ δόξης ἐγένου κοινωνός, ἀγῶνας πολυτρόπους ἐνεγκῶν διὰ τοῦτο σὲ Ὀρέστα ὡς νικητήν, τιμῶντες σοὶ ἐκβοῶμεν δόξα τῷ παρασχόντι σοι ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργούντι διὰ σοῦ, πάσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, Τοῦ λίθου σφραγισθέντος — the only hymn on the page of «Άγιος Ορέστης», and it names him.

english.text: Having confessed Christ before the impious, you pulled down the insolence of the madness for idols, prize-winner, and became a sharer of glory, bearing contests of many kinds. And so, honouring you as victor, Orestes, we cry out to you: glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who works healings for all through you.

hymns.text: Удом усекновение терпел еси/ и огненную лютую муку, мучениче,/ подвигся, всеславне,/ венцем яве увязеся нетленным, преблаженне,/ Престолу же предстоиши Святыя Троицы,/ Юже помоли, да спасет ны,/ мучениче Оресте,/ верою поющим тя.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 ноября ст. ст. — «Тропарь мученика Ореста врача», printed under his own name and his own trade

english.text: You endured the cutting of your limbs and the cruel torment of fire, O martyr; having striven, all-glorious one, you were plainly bound with an incorruptible crown, most blessed one, and you stand before the throne of the Holy Trinity. Entreat her, that she may save us who sing of you in faith, O martyr Orestes.

death.note: The year in the calendar's own bracket: days.pravoslavie.ru, 10 ноября ст. ст., «Мч. Ореста врача (304).», and its life page says the same in words — «Влачимый по камням, святой мученик отошел ко Господу в 304 году». Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave this folder a year.
